title: Rename filter case workbench
summary: Adds a Settings rename filter case workbench that tests current draft filters through the backend cleaner, compares actual/expected TV or movie results, stages backend suggestions into the unsaved Settings draft, and appends guarded regression cases.
reason: The previous Settings surface split live filename testing and bad-case logging, mixed TV/movie fields, and did not provide backend-authored filter suggestions for the operator to stage.
behavior_before: Settings exposed a simple rename test panel and a separate TV-oriented filter case log. The read-only clean filename preview returned only a cleaned target name, and the bad-case corpus accepted only tv_auto cases.
behavior_after: Settings exposes one workbench for movie or TV cases. The clean filename preview can return actual/expected fields, comparison rows, suggestions, and a case payload without mutation. Suggestions stage only into the browser draft until Save Settings is confirmed. The corpus accepts guarded tv_auto and movie_auto cases.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_rename_bad_case_corpus.py: movie_auto corpus append and confirmation coverage
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary -q -- failed on unrelated pre-existing dirty pipelineLogWindowBridge.js/Tauri bridge and command-owner drift; targeted rename boundary test passed

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage -- failed because 11 unrelated generated dependency-atlas/summary files are changed and not listed in any unreleased change packet
rollback_plan: Revert the workbench UI/JS changes, restore the previous Settings rename test and log panels, remove the added clean-filename-preview analysis fields and movie_auto corpus support, and revert the matching tests/inventories/generated summaries.
